extraction_notes: Capacitances were converted from pF to F and resistances from mOhm to ohm. Typical table values are Ciss=2700 pF, Coss=660 pF, and Crss=28 pF at VGS=0 V, VDS=30 V, f=1 MHz; min/max capacitance columns are 2025/3375 pF, 495/825 pF, and 8.5/56 pF respectively.
RDS(on) maximum table values are 0.0028 ohm at VGS=10 V, ID=50 A and 0.0042 ohm at VGS=6 V, ID=12.5 A.

IDSS typical/max are 0.5/1 uA at VDS=60 V, VGS=0 V, Tj=25 degC; at Tj=125 degC they are 10/100 uA. Gate charge typical is Qg=37 nC, Qgs=12 nC, Qgd=7 nC, Qg(th)=8 nC, Qsw=12 nC, with VDS=30 V, VGS=0 to 10 V, ID=50 A and Rg,ext=3 ohm for the Qg test.

Body-diode table values include VSD max=1.2 V at IF=50 A, trr typ=35 ns (min 14 ns, max 56 ns), and Qrr typ=29 nC (min 14 nC, max 58 nC) at VR=30 V, IF=50 A, diF/dt=100 A/us, Tc=25 degC. RthetaJC bottom max=1.5 K/W, top max=20 K/W, and RthetaJA max=50 K/W on the specified 6 cm2 cooling area.

The output, transfer, capacitance, diode, and gate-charge plots were examined. The output plot (p. 5) states Tj=25 degC but does not state dc/continuous/pulsed mode; the transfer plot has no fixed VDS (only an inequality); the capacitance plot (p. 6) has no stated temperature; and the gate-charge plot has no stated temperature. Under the supplied extraction rules no curve meets all required temperature, fixed-bias, and test-mode conditions, so curves are omitted.
omission_reason: No curve was retained: the p. 5 output plot lacks an explicit dc/continuous/pulsed test mode, the transfer plot lacks a single fixed VDS bias, the p. 6 capacitance plot has no stated temperature, and the p. 7 gate-charge plot has no stated temperature. No test mode or temperature was inferred.
